meta.title: Draw Your Room in 2D & 3D
meta.description: Draw your event room, place drape runs and a stage, then preview the same room design in an interactive 3D Studio.

hero.title: Draw your room and preview your event draping in 3D.
hero.description: Build a practical top-down room plan, place drape runs and a stage, then move into a fast interactive 3D view—without losing the precision of your original drawing.
hero.imageAlt: Luxury draped event space representing the room design Studio

templates.title: Start with the room shape you know.

rectangle.title: Rectangle room
rectangle.body: The most precise V1 workflow for ballrooms, halls, and event spaces.

lShape.title: L-shape room
lShape.body: Set the overall room and a practical rectangular cutout.

custom.title: Blank / custom
custom.body: Begin with a basic custom outline. Point editing expands in a later release.

draw.title: Draw to scale
draw.body: Start with room dimensions in feet and inches, then refine each wall.

drape.title: Place event draping
drape.body: Add full-wall treatments, partial runs, backdrops, and dividers.

preview.title: Preview in 3D
preview.body: The 3D room is generated directly from the same drawing data.

save.title: Save to your account
save.body: Keep designs with your estimates and event planning when signed in.

aiTeaser.title: AI design assistance is coming next.
aiTeaser.description: Today's Studio is manual by design. Floor-plan upload and AI-assisted suggestions are not part of this first release.
